literal_meaning: শরীরে মাংস জমা হওয়া বা লাগা
figurative_meaning_en: To become plump or fat; to gain good health
example_sentences_in_bangla: বছর খানেক ধরে সে ভালো খেয়ে গায়ে মাংস লাগিয়েছে।
বিদেশ থেকে ফিরে তার গায়ে মাংস লেগেছে, দেখতে সুস্থ লাগছে।
example_sentences_in_english: After eating well for a year, he's put on some meat and looks healthier.
She returned from abroad with flesh on her bones, appearing much healthier.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali emphasis on robust health and body weight as signs of prosperity and well-being.
